notes.title: OUR STEAM DEMO IS NOW LIVE ‼️
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378100/Killer_Chat__Definitive_Edition/][img]https://i.imgur.com/dNGkDKn.png[/img][/url]

Month 1 of Killer Chat! is now on Steam to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378100/Killer_Chat__Expanded_Edition/]download as a demo[/url]! 

[h2]Help us out, chat! 📢 
[/h2]We are building our presence on steam to help make KC bigger and better! Here are some ways you can give us hand!

[h2]Play the demo! 🔪 
[/h2]Playing demos helps game visibility on Steam. If you want to help us out, playing the demo helps us convert more rotterlings to the KC! community! More rotterlings = more investment in future Killer Chat content! 😈

To reward your help we’ve made a couple of small additions [b]exclusive to the demo[/b]! 
- Bonus dialogue 💭 
- Easter eggs! ❤️
- A couple small surprises! 🪽 

[h2]Wishlist Killer Chat! Expanded Edition 🩸 
[/h2]Expanded Edition is the new name for Definitive Edition! This game version will be much bigger, better and bloodier, and kickstarted in the Summer. Wishlisting makes it more visible to newcomers by telling steam that people love the game! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378100/Killer_Chat__Expanded_Edition/]If you haven’t wishlisted it already, you can do it here[/url].

[h2]Spread the word! 
[/h2]Liking and reposting our social media posts is another great way to help out. You guys are doing an amazing job at spreading the word, so keep up the good work!
